turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until twenty to five. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me, so start there.
You're welcome. Now, who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen out first?
"Okay" isn't an answer, Hale. I'm writing down that you didn't have one.
Seventeen minutes, and you've given me nothing. Talk to me now, or I'm going down the hall to the principal's office.
Withdraw the zero today, Hale. If you can't tell me why it's there, the principal will hear about this before I leave the building.
